description:
Investor Special in Prime Northridge Location! Opportunity knocks at 19607 Bryant Street—a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offering approximately 1,856 square feet of living space on a generous 7,504 square foot lot. Built in 1957, this property is ready for its next chapter and presents endless possibilities for investors, flippers, or buyers looking to create their dream home.

Situated in a desirable Northridge neighborhood, this fixer-upper offers great bones, abundant potential, and the chance to customize and add value. The spacious lot provides room for outdoor entertaining, expansion possibilities, or a future backyard retreat.

Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and everyday amenities, with easy access to the 118, 405, and 101 freeways for a seamless commute. Whether you're looking for your next renovation project or a home you can make your own, this is a rare opportunity to invest in a sought-after San Fernando Valley location.

Bring your vision and unlock the potential of this Northridge gem!
